sentences.en: The frog inflated himself more and more, until finally he burst.
sentences.zh: 这只青蛙不断地膨胀自己，直到最后终于爆了。

sentences.en: Have you ever inflated a balloon as big as this one?
sentences.zh: 你曾经吹过这么大的气球吗？

sentences.en: When I drink carbonated water my stomach quickly starts feeling inflated.
sentences.zh: 喝完碳酸饮料后我的肚子很快就感觉胀了起来。
